theorems.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (L : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ Tendsto (fun j => f (lams (φ j))) atTop (𝓝 L)) → Tendsto f (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L)
